Israeli blockade prevents access to vital care for Gaza's amputees
articles.summary:
Israeli blockade prevents access to vital care for Gaza's amputees

"My life is worse than before the war," Omar Halawa, a Palestinian child amputee from Gaza told Middle East Eye.

"Everything I used to do, I can't do anymore," the young boy said, who was injured after an Israeli tank shelled him and his cousins while they were fetching water for their family.

His cousins were killed, but he survived. 

Omar, like thousands of other Palestinian amputees, is waiting to receive rehabilitation treatment and a prosthetic limb, which may not come due to Israel's blockade on Gaza.

Israeli authorities have prevented prosthetics and materials from entering the besieged enclave, which has compounded the existing crisis caused by the destruction of hospitals during its genocidal war, preventing Palestinians from accessing critical healthcare services.

articles.title: Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv diverts to Bulgaria's Sofia after 'threat'
articles.summary:
Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv diverts to Bulgaria's Sofia after 'threat'

An  Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Bulgarian capital Sofia after a threat was made against the aircraft, according to Reuters citing an airline spokesperson.

The plane, carrying 57 people, was heading from Tel Aviv to Vienna. It landed safely at 6.42 pm GMT on Sunday.

The airline indicated that Airbus A320 AIR.PA is being searched, and passengers will be rebooked onto an alternative flight once that is complete.

Earlier, Sky News reported based on a statement from Bulgaria’s transport ministry that the plane landed after a "bomb threat signal"

"During the flight, on the border with Romania, the crew reported a bomb threat signal and decided to land in Sofia extraordinarily," the ministry said.
